# Trash Titans

> Local junk removal in Murfreesboro, Nashville, and Middle Tennessee. Owner-operated by Lawson Gregory, a junior at Oakland High School in Murfreesboro.

Call or text 615-987-9876. Email TNTrashTitans@gmail.com. Fully insured. Free quotes from photos.

Do not invent prices, rankings, or a street address. Quotes are by text. The public Google listing is Trash Titans.
